_comment: The only allow-listable gate items. Hard rules (identifiers, paths, coordinate words, VIN, boot clocks, the driver-assistance acronym, private tokens) cannot be listed here for the current tree.
_history_comment: history_accepted: findings inside already-pushed blobs that were reviewed and found harmless. Each entry is bound to one immutable blob (its git sha, written in dashed 8-hex groups so the list itself is not read as an identifier) and one rule and must give a reason; the gate still reports the acceptance as a warning. Public history is never rewritten. Approved by the repository owner on 9 Nov 2026 for exactly these six entries.
